[SWS_TS_00056]
⌈
If the absolute value of the time offset between Global
Time Base and local instance of the Time Base (abs(TG - TLSync)) is equal or greater
than ’OffsetCorrectionJumpThreshold’, the TBR shall calculate the corrected
time (TL) of its local instance of the Time Base according to the following formula:
TL = TG + (TV - TVSync) * rrc
- TV = Current value of the Virtual Local Time
- TVSync = Value of the Virtual Local Time
- TG = Received value of the Global Time
- rrc = Most current rate for correcting the local instance of the Time Base
⌋
